statement: Sharp singularity rates for symmetric random sign matrices. Determines the sharp exponential singularity rate of symmetric random sign matrices with independent entries on and above the diagonal. Uniform signs give $`\Pr(\det A_n=0)=(1/2+o(1))^n`$; for fixed bias $`p\in(0,1)\setminus\{1/2\}`$, the rate is $`(p^2+(1-p)^2+o(1))^n`$. In the biased case, agreeing rows attain this rate.
